title: Multi-DODAG simulation validation
description: Validate the multi-DODAG architecture with the Python simulator at event scale. Simulate: (1) 200-node single DODAG baseline, (2) 2000-node 10-DODAG DEF CON layout, (3) 8000-node 40-DODAG Burning Man layout. Measure: announce airtime overhead, DAO convergence time, cross-DODAG message delivery latency, custody chain completion rate. Python simulator work.
